description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Warp stripes style, generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. 4-color palette (#000000, #1F51FF, #00E5FF, #EAFDFF). Features: high intensity. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
